OBITUARY REFERENCE 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Hon'ble Members, I refer with profound sorrow to the 
passing away of Shri M. Rajasekara Murthy, a sitting Member, on the 5th 
of December 2010, at the age of 88 years. Born in May, 1922, District 
Mysore (Karnataka) Shri Murthy had his education at Mysore University and 
Lucknow University. 
A political and social worker, Shri Murthy had participated in the 
freedom struggle. An economist and an educationist, Shri Murthy had 
worked as Honorary Secretary for several educational institutions in the 
State of Karnataka. He also established several schools and colleges. 
Shri M. Rajasekara Murthy started his legislative career as a Member 
of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly in 1952. He was Member of that 
Assembly from 1952 to 1978 and 1989 to 1994. He held several portfolios 
in the Government of Karnataka. He was Minister of Industry, Information 
and Publicity and Film Development from 1968 to 1971; Minister of Finance 
and Excise from 1989 to 1990 and Minister of Revenue and Religious 
Endowments from 1992 to 1993. He was a Member of the Seventh Lok Sabha 
from 1980 to 1984. He had also served as Union Minister of Surface 
Transport (Independent Charge) from September, 1995 to June, 1996. 
Shri Murthy represented the State of Karnataka in this House from 
April, 1994 to August, 1999; April, 2002 to November, 2005 and from 
April, 2006 till his sad demise. 
In the passing away of Shri M. Rajasekara Murthy, the country has lost 
a veteran freedom fighter, an able administrator and a distinguished 
parliamentarian. 
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri M. Rajasekara Murthy. 
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a 
mask of respect to the memory of the deaprted.
